About

I’m a Computer Science and AI student at IE University. I’m Jordanian. I grew up in Dubai and now I live in Madrid.

I’m into full-stack AI engineering, mostly AI workflows and orchestration. I like working fast, and I like problems that need real system design.

I’m looking for work. If you’re building something with AI, email me.

02

Career

FOUNDER · NOW

Pharmable

I’m building AI that reviews pharmaceutical documents against health regulations before they’re submitted.

AWARD · 3RD OF 18 TEAMS

First Claude Hackathon in Madrid

A 48-hour hackathon where AI agents traded in a live game and every deal had to be negotiated. Our agent negotiated on its own and learned from the other teams as the game went on. It also ran its own marketplace where other teams traded.

INTERNSHIP

AI Engineer · Optimiza

I built an AI tool that turns raw meeting transcripts into clear summaries and flags moments where a client is unhappy. People used to do that review by hand. I also set up IIS web services on virtual machines and built a chatbot with Hugging Face Transformers and TensorFlow, served through Flask.

INTERNSHIP

Data Scientist · British Airways

I built a system that collected over 13,000 records of competitor fares and seat availability across six routes over two years. The data showed a 29% rise in winter delays. It also showed demand dropping as fares went up on every route, which shaped how the airline scheduled capacity.

AWARD · 1ST PLACE

EDP × IE Datathon

We worked on running battery storage systems more efficiently. The batteries charge when solar makes more power than the grid needs and release it when demand goes up. We forecast supply and demand with multivariate time series, and our model ranked first in accuracy.

RESEARCH

IE Tech Lab × Bloomberg

I helped build an ESG trust score sponsored by Bloomberg, which rates how companies do on sustainability. We also made a simpler Bloomberg Terminal for everyday investors. I worked directly with the Bloomberg team.

RESEARCH

IE Econ Data Lab × UNDP

A study for the United Nations Development Programme on how cities in North America and South Asia invest in resilience against disasters. We used economic time series data covering many years.

C++20PYTHONQUANT FINANCE

Schrödinger Local Vol

Prices SPX options by solving a Schrödinger equation in imaginary time with a C++ Crank-Nicolson solver. I backtested it on 1.2 million real SPX quotes against SVI, Heston and the practitioner smile. It had zero butterfly arbitrage across 2,019 holdout slices.

04

Game Dev

Hand-drawn canvas

Everything you see is drawn on a 2D canvas with my own code. There’s no game engine and no libraries.

Walking around

Move with the keyboard or the touch pad. Buildings and trees block you, and a prompt shows up when you’re close to something.

Cabins you can enter

Every cabin has its own furnished room. The book on the lectern opens that part of the portfolio.

Opening scene

When you start, the camera flies down to my cabin and I walk out the door to say hi.

A living farm

The farm at the bottom of the page runs on small loops, like a farmer fetching water and a camper burning marshmallows.

Accessibility

It respects reduced motion and works with a keyboard alone. You can read every section without playing.

A cozy woodland homestead: a farmhouse with a grandfather rocking on the porch, a vegetable garden and scarecrow, a stone well, a turning windmill, a washing line and beehives, with a farmer and dog doing chores above a paddock of horses, highland cows, chickens and pigs.
